name: tether-host
description: Tether host agent - lets the Tether iOS app control this Windows or macOS machine

scripts.build:native: node -e "const cp=process.getBuiltinModule('node:child_process');const p=process.platform;if(p!=='win32'&&p!=='darwin'){console.error('[build:native] no native helper for '+p);process.exit(1)}const win=p==='win32';const f=win?'powershell':'/bin/bash';const a=win?['-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','native/build.ps1']:['native/build-mac.sh'];try{cp.execFileSync(f,a,{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.error('[build:native] '+(win?'native/build.ps1':'native/build-mac.sh')+' failed: '+e.message);process.exit(1)}"
